capabilities: Edit notes live with other people
Submit, approve and publish changes as GitHub pull requests
Sync a linked folder in the background
Create a GitHub repository from a local vault
extras: Free plan covers one repository and five publishes a month; Pro and Pro Plus are paid per seat. The plugin is MIT open source, but the specgit web app and realtime service are closed source. An Advanced setting can point the plugin at a custom specgit server.
motivation: To bring specgit's browser-based visual editor for Obsidian vaults inside Obsidian, connecting saving, commenting and publishing to GitHub commits, review threads and merges.
problem: Keeping a vault in step across devices or with a team on GitHub causes colliding edits, feedback scattered across tools, and requires everyone to learn Git.

relations.evidence: This plugin brings the best of specgit inside Obsidian on desktop and phone
connecting everyday actions (saving, commenting, and publishing) directly to how GitHub works

requires.name: specgit account signed in with GitHub
specgit Pro or Pro Plus plan

summary: Plugin that links a vault folder to a GitHub repository for live co-editing, inline comments, review and publishing.
